enriched_activities.desc: Lie face-down on the bed in Bedroom 2. Pull the blanket over the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Place the left arm under the pillow. Keep eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Stretch the legs out. Turn back onto the back. Place both arms on top of the blanket. Turn onto the left side again. Pull the pillow toward the head. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Shift the head to the other side of the pillow. Continue lying with eyes closed. Turn onto the right side. Kick the blanket down to the waist. Pull the blanket back up over the chest. Remain lying without moving until the alarm clock on the phone rings.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and taking a hot shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Reach the right hand to the phone on the bedside table and press the alarm button to stop the alarm. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Put on the slippers. Walk from Bedroom 2 to the Bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the WaterHeater. Pull the shower curtain aside. Turn the shower tap to the hot position. Step into the shower area. Wet the hair and body under the running water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms, chest, and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Pull the towel off the hook. Wipe the hair with the towel. Wipe the face, arms, and body. Step out of the shower area. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Walk out of the Bathroom. Turn off the bathroom light and the WaterHeater.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1, boiling water for coffee and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to Bedroom 2. Open the wardrobe. Take out a shirt and a pair of trousers. Put on the clothes. Walk to the Kitchen. Greet Member 1 and say: "Good morning, did you sleep well?" Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread on the counter. Pick up two slices of bread and put them into the Toaster. Press the Toaster lever down. Pick up the Kettle. Fill the Kettle with water from the tap. Place the Kettle on the base. Press the Kettle switch to boil. Open the cupboard. Take out two coffee mugs. Place the mugs on the counter. Take out the coffee jar. Open the coffee jar lid. Scoop coffee powder into both mugs with a spoon. Close the coffee jar lid. Put the coffee jar back into the cupboard. Pick up the plates from the cupboard. Place two plates on the counter. When the Toaster pops, pick up the toast and put one slice on each plate. Pick up the knife. Spread butter on the toast. Pour hot water from the Kettle into both mugs. Stir the coffee with the spoon. Pick up the plate. Sit on the chair at the table with Member 1. Eat the toast. Pick up the mug with the right hand. Drink the coffee. Say to Member 1: "I need to leave at 7:45." Put the mug down on the table. Finish eating. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Place them in the sink. Walk out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts organization office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to the entryway. Pick up the backpack from the floor. Put the backpack on both shoulders. Put on the shoes. Open the entry door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk along the sidewalk toward the bus stop. Stop at the crosswalk. Press the pedestrian crossing button. Cross the street when the light changes. Continue walking along the sidewalk. Reach the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus when it arrives. Take the transit card out of the pocket. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Place the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the bus approaches the stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk along the sidewalk to the office building. Push the glass door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the office door. Push the door open. Walk to the desk. Take off the backpack. Place the backpack beside the desk. Sit on the office chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: coordinating exhibition schedules, replying to emails, and attending program meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Press the power button on the office computer. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse to open the email program. Click on the first email in the inbox. Read the email. Click the reply button. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click send. Open the second email. Read the email. Type a reply. Click send. Open the calendar program. Click on the exhibition dates in the calendar. Drag an exhibition entry to a new date. Type the revised dates into the calendar entry. Save the entry. Open the spreadsheet file with the exhibition schedule. Type the artist names into the cells. Save the file. Stand up. Pick up the notebook and pen. Walk to the meeting room. Sit on a chair at the meeting table. Open the notebook. Write notes with the pen while the program coordinator speaks. Raise the right hand. Say: "The installation date needs to move one week later." Write down the decision in the notebook. Close the notebook. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Pick up the phone. Dial the artist's number. Speak into the phone about the delivery date of the artworks. End the call. Place the phone on the desk. Open the document file for the exhibition checklist. Type the item list on the keyboard. Save the document. Click print. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Place the pages in a folder. Open the email program again. Read new emails. Reply to two emails. Click send for each.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating at a nearby cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the office chair. Take the wallet out of the backpack. Put the wallet into the pocket. Walk out of the office. Walk along the sidewalk to the cafe. Push the cafe door open. Walk to the counter. Look at the menu board. Say to the staff: "One sandwich and a small coffee, please." Take the wallet out of the pocket. Open the wallet. Take out a bank card. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the wallet. Put the wallet into the pocket. Pick up the cup of coffee from the counter. Pick up the plate with the sandwich. Walk to an empty table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the sandwich with both hands. Take bites of the sandwich. Chew and swallow. Pick up the cup with the right hand. Drink the coffee. Put the cup down. Finish the sandwich. Pick up the plate and the cup. Stand up. Walk to the return counter. Place the plate and cup on the tray. Walk to the cafe door. Push the door open. Walk back along the sidewalk to the office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: drafting grant reports, liaising with artists, and planning upcoming events
enriched_activities.desc: Push the office door open. Walk to the desk. Sit on the office chair. Open the grant report document on the computer. Type the budget figures on the keyboard. Scroll down the page with the mouse. Type the project description paragraph. Save the document. Click the print button. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed report pages. Walk back to the desk. Place the report pages in a folder. Open the document file for the upcoming event plan. Type the event date and venue into the table. Type the guest list into the table. Save the file. Pick up the phone. Dial the artist's number. Speak into the phone about the loan agreement for the artwork. Write notes on the notepad with the pen. End the call. Place the phone on the desk. Open the email program. Attach the grant report file to an email. Type the recipient address. Type a short message. Click send. Pick up the phone again. Dial the gallery contact. Speak about the delivery schedule. End the call. Write the confirmed schedule on the notepad. Open the event budget spreadsheet. Type the cost items into the cells. Save the spreadsheet. Close the spreadsheet. Stand up. Walk to the filing cabinet. Pull the drawer open. Place the folder inside. Push the drawer closed. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Turn off the computer monitor. Stand up. Pick up the backpack. Put the backpack on both shoulders.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home, stopping briefly at an art supply shop
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the office building. Walk along the sidewalk toward the bus stop. Stop at the art supply shop. Push the shop door open. Walk to the shelf. Pick up two sketchbooks. Pick up a set of pens. Walk to the counter. Place the sketchbooks and pens on the counter. Take the wallet out of the pocket. Open the wallet. Take out a bank card. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the wallet. Put the wallet into the pocket. Pick up the plastic bag with the sketchbooks and pens. Say "Thank you" to the shop staff. Walk out of the shop. Continue walking to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Step onto the bus. Take the transit card out of the pocket. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Place the plastic bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop near home. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk to the apartment building. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the apartment door. Take the keys out of the pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door. Take off the shoes. Take off the backpack. Place the backpack on the floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Place the plastic bag with the sketchbooks on the counter. Say to Member 1: "I bought new sketchbooks, I'll show you after dinner." Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Push the cut vegetables into a bowl. Turn on the InductionCooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir the vegetables with the spatula. Pour water into the pan. Put the lid on the pan. Crack two eggs into a bowl. Beat the eggs with chopsticks. Pour the eggs into another pan. Stir the eggs. Turn off the InductionCooker. Pick up the plates. Put the rice and the dishes onto the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit on the chair with Member 1. Eat dinner. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up the bowl. Say to Member 1: "The exhibition opening is next Friday." Put the bowl down. Continue eating. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the plates and bowls to the sink. Place them in the sink. Walk back to the table. Wipe the table with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Helping Member 1 wash dishes and clean kitchen counters after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Pick up a plate. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the running water. Place the plate on the drying rack. Pick up a bowl. Wipe the bowl with the sponge. Rinse the bowl. Place the bowl on the drying rack. Pick up the chopsticks. Rub them with the sponge. Rinse them. Place them on the drying rack. Pick up the pan. Wipe the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan. Place the pan on the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter surface with the cloth. Wipe the stove top with the cloth. Pick up the crumbs with the hand. Throw the crumbs into the trash bin. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Say to Member 1: "The kitchen is done." Walk out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Sit on the sofa next to Member 1. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button to turn on the TV. Press the channel button to change the channel. Place the remote on the sofa cushion. Lean back against the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Say to Member 1: "How was your day at the office?" Turn the head toward Member 1 while listening. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down on the coffee table. Stand up from the sofa when Member 1 leaves the Living Room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions at the desk using computer monitor and desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Living Room to Bedroom 2. Push the door open. Walk to the desk. Sit on the chair at the desk. Turn on the DeskLamp. Press the power button on the Computer. Press the power button on the Monitor. Move the mouse to open the illustration file. Pick up the stylus pen. Draw lines on the drawing tablet. Press the keyboard shortcut to zoom in. Draw the character outline. Press the keyboard shortcut to zoom out. Click the color palette with the stylus. Fill the character shape with color. Press the undo shortcut. Draw the shape again. Pick up the plastic bag from the floor. Open the bag. Take out the new sketchbook. Place the sketchbook on the desk. Open the sketchbook. Pick up a pencil. Draw rough sketches on the paper. Close the sketchbook. Put the pencil down. Turn the head to the Monitor. Continue drawing on the tablet with the stylus. Save the file with the keyboard shortcut. Get up from the chair. Walk to the Kitchen and back with a glass of water. Sit down again. Continue drawing on the tablet. Save the file again. Stand up. Stretch both arms above the head. Turn off the Monitor. Turn off the Computer. Turn off the DeskLamp. Walk out of Bedroom 2.

Walk from Bedroom 2 to the Bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands under the water. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze cleanser into the left palm. Rub the cleanser over the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush into the cup. Pick up the towel again. Wipe the hands. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with a cup of tea and light reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to the Kitchen. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug and a tea bag. Place the tea bag into the mug. Pick up the Kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Place the Kettle back on the base. Pick up the mug. Carry the mug to the Living Room. Place the mug on the coffee table. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the book from the coffee table. Open the book to the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Place the mug back on the coffee table. Turn another page. Read for several minutes. Close the book. Place the book on the coffee table. Pick up the mug. Stand up. Carry the mug to the Kitchen. Place the mug in the sink. Turn off the Living Room light. Walk to Bedroom 2.

Walk into Bedroom 2. Push the door partly closed. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pull the blanket back. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Place the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Arrange the blanket over the chest. Close the eyes. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Remain lying without moving. Turn onto the back again. Keep breathing steadily with eyes closed. Remain asleep.
